root_causes: Platform header lacked a global Catalog entry; the Platform catalogue destination helper returned /platform.
Login preserved a previous tenant URL in history redirect state and returned a different account there before refreshing memberships.
Return hints were not validated against the current account; in-flight tenant response/error results lacked a central post-response account check.
before_evidence: The browser reproduced an approved Platform-only login being returned to /staff/libraries/e6d1e5b4-c48f-4b47-b96a-656a676fb8ae/inventory. Exact Library not found wording was not captured, so the literal-text reproduction flag is NO.
repairs: Existing owner-scoped persisted selections and request-version checks reused.
Library login returns pass through AccountLanding for fresh membership resolution.
One ProductSessionBoundary applies across auth, main and personal layouts.
One authorized route/return-context resolver validates the current account and role, including demotion.
Tenant request queues are keyed by session and UUID; stale successes and failures abort.
